mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, workspace_id, name, params, created_at FROM saved_view WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, workspace_id, name, params, created_at FROM saved_view WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND name = #{name} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_view (id, user_id, workspace_id, name, params) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{params})
mapper.update: UPDATE saved_view SET params = #{params} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
